# The lift is out again

The lift at Mum's station is broken. The railway app says a replacement route is available but sends her across a footbridge. She stayed home from the choir. Record the failed trip as a lost activity, not a transport inconvenience that disappears when the lift is repaired. [[Care arrangements]] may need a second contact for days when I cannot answer immediately.
